featured_reviews.review_text:
Regretful Experience – Strongly Not Recommended

I deeply regret choosing this website development company.  Their work was highly unprofessional and basic, far from what I expected specially the support? I had to chase them continuously just to get the job done. The website they delivered has not even lasted for one year.

Their communication is extremely poor — We didn't come across any stability with them, and when they finally respond, it’s very defensive behaviour. The lack of professionalism is evident in every interaction. I now have to look for another, more reliable vendor who can handle the project with the professionalism and stability this company severely lacks.

Also, be very careful with the terms they present — always get everything in black & white. I honestly wonder how they’ve managed to maintain such a good online rating. As an IT and digital marketing company, I wouldn’t be surprised though ? I strongly advise avoiding this company at all costs unless you want to deal with frustration and regret like I did. And I won't be surprised by their response, which will likewise represent their work and the responses they're used to providing clients.
